title: Enchanted Villager Archers
description: A modern Fabric mod featuring dynamic equipment and advanced AI, allowing villagers to defend themselves effectively.
body:

Dynamic Equipment System: Villagers equip their bows only when a threat is detected within 10 blocks. Once the area is cleared, they automatically hide their gear and return to their civilian state.
Enhanced Weaponry: All villager bows are pre-enchanted with Power V. Additionally, there is a 20% chance for a Punch II enchantment to keep enemies at bay.
Advanced AI Integration: Instead of panicking under pressure, villagers take defensive stances and engage hostiles with professional archery skills.
